Danish

Etymology 1

From Old Danish annær or annæn, (andræ pl), from Old Norse annarr, from Proto-Germanic *anþeraz (“second, other”).

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /ˈanən/, [ˈænn̩]

Pronoun

anden (neuter singular andet, plural andre, no definite forms)

  1. other, another, else
    Den anden bil er større.
    The other car is bigger.

Numeral

anden (neuter singular andet, plural andre, no definite forms)

20

    Ordinal: anden
Danish Wikipedia article on 2

    Den anden bil er større.
    The second car is bigger.
